system.description:
Usage worn.

Each dark stone bead carries the name of someone whose death taught its former owner something worth remembering.

You gain a +1-status bonus to Religion and Occultism checks made to Recall Knowledge concerning Undead, Unliving creatures, funerary practices, necromancy and the passage of souls.

You also gain the Voice of the Dead ability:

Voice of the Dead:

Activate Command (1 AP)

Frequency 1/day

For 10 minutes, you may communicate with a corpse as though using Dead Tongue, subject to all normal limitations of that spell.

On the sheet: +1 status is offered on Religion and Occultism Recall Knowledge about the dead; Voice of the Dead is Dead Tongue as an innate spell, 1/day, for 10 minutes.

Pillars of Faith, Chapter 11.
